description: Unified shared base of Neuralese direct v1 for both lines (line parity, owner 2026-10-11; plans/neuralese/LINE_PARITY.md). Same stage as neuralese-direct-v1 with: (1) the data declared here, the root-adopted 4962-document text union (3258 train / 1704 held; a strict superset of the V9 set with the same held documents), which the CLI cannot substitute; a line whose tokenizer differs binds its registered tokenizer twin (same documents, ids, splits and source groups); (2) a shared context capacity of tokens 32768 (capacity 32768 - target_tokens, so every document of the union keeps its whole preceding context); target_tokens is a per-line memory knob and steps x target_tokens x batch (2,048,000 supervised positions) stays equal across lines; (3) one monitor for both lines: Pop's 48 clean-base probes (12 each plain exact math, tool, open answer, natlang test turn) as the in-run captured drift reference and as the behaviour gate's probes, each line declaring its own measured base gate_pass; (4) the shared cadence policy: eval and full-state checkpoints at the stage end (plus the checkpoint at half way and the final/emergency saves), the drift monitor and gate-at-warn at a cadence keeping evaluation near 3% of wall time, set per line from measured seconds (fit-only).
